transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because of a situation at work. I work in human resources, and... I pushed ahead with our new onboarding launch. I went ahead and committed company money and vendor time before the actual approvals were in place. 

At the time, it just felt... bold, you know? Like it was completely necessary to just get it done and move things forward. But now I'm on leave, and everyone is asking what I was thinking. So, that's why I'm here today.
Around the time you committed the money, did you need much less sleep than usual?
No, not really. I mean... I think my sleep was pretty normal around that time. I wasn't staying up all night or anything, if that's what you mean. I was just getting my usual amount of rest.
Around the time you committed the money, did you feel unusually elevated or irritable compared with your normal mood?

Yeah, both, actually. For the past few weeks, I've felt... well, brilliantly alive. Like I could finally show leadership what HR can really be. But on the other hand, I would get suddenly furious if someone questioned me. Even over really minor things, like small edits or just routine budget questions.
Before these past few weeks, had you often made similarly impulsive decisions even when your mood felt normal?

No, not really. I mean, I might make a quick call on something minor here and there, but nothing like this. Usually, I'm pretty careful about following the proper channels and getting approvals. This whole thing with the onboarding launch... it was definitely out of character for me.
During those few weeks, did you have noticeably more energy or take on more activities than usual?

Yeah, definitely. I've had a lot more energy. I keep arriving to work early, and I'm just constantly walking the floors. I've been rewriting decks, emailing people, rearranging plans... it's honestly like my body has a motor in it. Just sitting still at my desk feels almost impossible.
How long did this unusually energized and irritable state last continuously?

Well, it's been building up for about a month now. I think it really started right around the time the new executive came in and started challenging my whole onboarding redesign. So, yeah, it's been pretty constant since then.
During this period, have other people commented that you were talking much more or faster than usual?

Yeah, they have. Actually, I can even hear it myself when I'm in meetings. I just... I start talking a lot faster, and going on much longer than I normally would. I'll find myself jumping straight from employee engagement over to, like, gallery layouts, and then right into retention metrics. It gets to the point where people practically have to raise their hands just to get a word in and stop me.
Before this current period, have you ever had another distinct period when you felt unusually elevated or irritable and had much more energy than usual?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where work gets busy and I'm focused, but nothing like this. This... this feels completely different. I can't recall ever feeling this revved up before.
Before this current energized period, have you ever had a distinct period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most days?

No, I haven't. I mean, sure, I get stressed or tired from work sometimes, like anyone else, but never a time where I felt depressed or just stopped caring about things for weeks at a time. Honestly, my mood has always been pretty steady before this recent stretch.
